typeDescriptions.TRUE_FALSE: Decide whether the statement is true.
typeDescriptions.FREE_TEXT: Answer in your own words — graded by AI against your sources.
typeDescriptions.MATCHING: Match each item on the left with its partner.
typeDescriptions.ORDERING: Put the items in the correct order.

modeDescriptions.PRACTICE: Fresh questions from your material with instant feedback.
modeDescriptions.ADAPTIVE: Adjusts difficulty to your level and targets concepts you keep missing.
modeDescriptions.REVIEW: Practise what you previously got wrong — retry or test the same concepts in new ways.
modeDescriptions.EXAM: Timed, distraction-free conditions. Results only at the end.
modeDescriptions.SELECTION: Questions generated from a highlighted passage.
modeDescriptions.SHARED: A quiz shared with project members.

tips.references: Every question keeps a reference to the page it came from.
tips.mistakes: Wrong answers feed the adaptive engine — mistakes make you stronger.
tips.explain: Explaining an answer out loud is one of the best ways to remember it.
